scope: Compare already produced compact native observer records for the three F1-S2 spatial grids in solver-component coordinates. This contract never reads BI4/H5/VTK and never treats a neighboring grid as truth.

source_control_gate.motion_policy: No moving/floating control tag in the three bound F1-S2 generated XML files; this is a source fact, not a physical no-force claim.
source_control_gate.resolution_exception: definition dp and generated discrete count/mass may differ by grid; do not normalize them away
source_control_gate.owner_geometry: continuum owner geometry/mass is unresolved and remains UNKNOWN

native_observation_gate.role_policy: fluid-only aggregates; fixed/moving/floating groups must be counted separately and excluded
native_observation_gate.mass_policy: use native MassFluid; XML mass is never a native fallback
native_observation_gate.time_policy: decoded saved seconds/RunPARTs only; frame index is not time
native_observation_gate.producer_join: each report must be bound to the actual ROOT207 proof identity/SHA; missing or mismatched proof is a hard worker failure

supports: finite weighted arithmetic on an asymmetric six-particle fixture
reader_calibration_prerequisite.binding_policy: metadata prerequisite only; actual F1-S2 producer reports still require their own ROOT207 identity/receipt/proof join

comparison.same_time_operation: report component-space COM/velocity/KE/mass deltas only when actual saved timestamps match
comparison.asynchronous_operation: report lower/upper frame IDs, actual times, and bracket width; do not interpolate
